relation_tests: all 13 fixed vectors on selected lifts; on every public hit, test every valid frozen candidate by exact rational group law
retention: retain all public vectors, every candidate attempt including failures, and every public-hit candidate outcome; missing phase means unknown, not zero
selection_rule: minimum full-model height max bit length of A,B,x1,y1,x2,y2, lexicographic shift tie; selection completed before vector tests
